title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Strawberry Ice Cream Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Strawberry Ice Cream Nic Salt blends ripe, sweet Strawberry with a smooth, creamy Ice Cream base. The result is a comforting vape with subtle dessert richness and a mellow fruit top note. Formulated at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using refillable pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for smooth, satisfying nicotine delivery. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
